key_findings: Bond order as feature → r=0.74 for BE (valid: BO correlates with BE)
Snap dynamics carry NO linear signal for bond order or energy
Bond order classification: 77% accuracy (k-NN) — better than chance
Same-element pairs cannot be distinguished (O=O vs O-O identical Data Objects)
The encoding captures ELEMENT IDENTITY well but not BOND CONTEXT
Nonlinear methods (tree, neural) may extract what linear models cannot
conclusion: The Data Object encoding successfully captures element identity and predicts bond energy when bond order is provided (r=0.74 CV). Bond order itself is not linearly encodable in the current 24-bit representation. The snap dynamics carry rich information about the Golay structure but this information does not translate to chemical predictions via linear models. Next step: nonlinear predictors or encoding bond context explicitly.
